The '''Salissia system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the point of origin of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] group known as [[Salissian/Legends|Salissians]].<ref name="MS" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Salissia system lay outside the borders of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Salissia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square T-5.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
